notes: Delete of a stored fact. Siemens's primary listing is stored by name (w1) or through its index (w2, a rule over index_constituent_of that gives nothing once the membership is deleted). q0 names the DAX by description; the description is the stored bridge, so it is asked of the DAX. Relations once declared in this file are catalogued in RELATIONS.md since 2026-10-30. q1 ('the same national benchmark index as Allianz') and q3 ('the same city as the ECB's headquarters') are joins over named individuals; Allianz in the DAX, the DAX a national benchmark, the ECB in Frankfurt and the exchange in Frankfurt are their bridges (firm). Relabelled dl on 2026-10-31 (COVERAGE.md label corrections); the fol section keeps its Z3 encoding as a second check.

queries.ask: siemens : index_constituent_of some (NationalBenchmark and inv(index_constituent_of) value allianz)
siemens : primary_listing some (located_in some (City and inv(headquartered_in) value ecb))

fol.notes: One uninterpreted sort. primary_listing and home_exchange are functions (a company has one primary listing, an index one home exchange); 'same city' needs an exchange or a headquarters to stand in one city (firm) and the named cities distinct. As the DL file: Siemens's primary listing stored by name (w1) or as the home exchange of the national benchmark index it belongs to (w2). Delete: Siemens's index is left open, so q1 and w2's listing city are not known.

exchange_cities.says: The Frankfurt Stock Exchange is in Frankfurt.

one_city.says: An exchange stands in one city.
one_city.z3: ForAll([x, c, d], Implies(And(city(c), city(d), located_in(x, c), located_in(x, d)), c == d))

home_exchanges.says: The DAX's home exchange is the Frankfurt Stock Exchange; the DAX is a national benchmark index.

ecb_frankfurt.says: The European Central Bank is headquartered in Frankfurt. (stored)

allianz_dax.says: Allianz is a constituent of the DAX. (stored)

stores: ForAll(i, Implies(And(national_benchmark(i), index_constituent_of(siemens, i)), primary_listing(siemens) == home_exchange(i)))

queries.ask: Exists(i, And(national_benchmark(i), index_constituent_of(siemens, i), index_constituent_of(allianz, i)))
Exists(c, And(city(c), located_in(primary_listing(siemens), c), headquartered_in(ecb) == c))
